envelope.description: Change convertLegacyFeedback to the s5 mapping

body.title: Change convertLegacyFeedback to the s5 mapping
body.summary: In src/workflow/artifact-core/feedback-convert.ts: the actor id is the author text lower-cased when it is already an os:, git: or github: id, else legacy:<slug of the author> with the author text in actor.properties.name; kind is revision-request when the entry's decision or kind is feedback, suggestion stays, the rest comment; a target.file other than the artifact's own document goes to anchor.section and is no longer reported unmapped; id, timestamp, batchId and revision are kept. Update src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/feedback-convert.test.ts and add src/workflow/convert/__tests__/convert-feedback.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: A namespaced author is kept lower-cased and any other author becomes legacy:<slug> with the text in actor.properties.name
Decision or kind feedback is revision-request, suggestion stays suggestion, the rest comment
A foreign target.file lands in anchor.section and is not reported unmapped
id, timestamp, batchId and revision are kept

tests.name: convert-feedback.test.ts: each mapping of convertLegacyFeedback from the s5 hand-off (actor, kind, anchor section, kept fields)
